examShortTricks: Trick 1: Dehydrating evidence: sugar → black carbon column (C12H22O11 —11H2O→ 12C); also dehydrates formic acid to CO — the 'charring' observation scores.
Trick 2: Oxidising: Cu + 2H2SO4(conc.) → CuSO4 + SO2 + 2H2O (hot); C → CO2; S → SO2.
Trick 3: Acidic: dibasic → two salt series (sulphates and bisulphates); 'king of chemicals' — highest tonnage chemical, used in fertilisers, batteries, refining petroleum.
